CITY COUNCIL
  REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
  June 3, 2026 – 7:00 P.M.
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  5938 KAUFFMAN AVENUE - TEMPLE CITY

PROCEDURE TO ADDRESS CITY COUNCIL:
In person: Members of the Public who wish to address the City Council may do so by completing
a Speaker Request Form, indicating the agenda item number and submitting it to the City Clerk.
Unless waived by Council, t here is a 3-minute time limit on each speaker with a maximum
period of 30 minutes for comments on any subject.

Written Comment: Written public comments received by 5pm on the day of the meeting will be
provided to the City Council and made part of the meeting record. Written public comments will
not be read aloud by city staff or City Council.
You have the opportunity to address the City Council at the following times:
  •  Agenda item: at the time the Council considers the agenda item;
  •  Non-agenda item: at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while the
  City Council values your comments, pursuant to the Brown Act, the Council cannot
  take action on any item not listed on the agenda; and
  •  Public Hearing: at the time for public hearings under PUBLIC HEARING.

The listing of any item on the agenda includes the authority of the Council to take action
on such item and to approve, disapprove, or give directions on any item.

NOTICE: Staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business of this
Agenda are available for viewing on the City’s website at templecityca.gov and are on file and
available for review during regular office hours in the Office of the City Clerk located at City Hall,
9701 Las Tunas Drive, Temple City, California. Written documentation submitted to the City
Council after distribution of the agenda packet can be obtained at the City Clerk’s Office during
regular office hours.

ACCESSIBILITY: In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special
assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk at (626) 285-2171.
Notification 72 hours prior to the meeting will enable the City to make reasonable arrangements
to ensure accessibility to this meeting.

TO WATCH REGULAR MEETINGS LIVE OR RECORDED, VISIT:
https://www.youtube.com/@ConnectWithTC

AGENDA NOTIFICATION SUBSCRIPTION:
If you wish to receive an agenda email notification, please email your request to
cityclerk@templecityca.gov or call (626) 285-2171.

7. CONSENT CALENDAR

  All Consent Calendar items may be approved in a single motion as recommended
  unless removed for further discussion. If members of the City Council or persons in the
  audience wish to discuss any matters listed on the Consent Calendar, please address
  them at this time.
  Recommendation:  Approve Items A through H per recommendations.

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The City Council is requested to review and approve the:

  1. Minutes of the Regular City Council Meeting of May 19, 2026; and
  2. Minutes of the Special City Council Meeting of May 27, 2026.

  Recommendation:  Approve the Minutes of the City Council Meeting.

  Attachments:  Minutes of May 19, 2026
  Minutes of May 27, 2026

  B. PLANNING COMMISSION ACTIONS - MEETING OF MAY 12, 2026

  The City Council is requested to receive and file the Planning Commission Actions
  from their meeting on May 12, 2026.

  Recommendation:  Receive and file the Planning Commission
  meeting actions.

  Attachment:  Staff Report
 City Council Agenda
June 3, 2026
Page 3 of 8

  C. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 26-5875 APPROVING PARTICIPATION IN
  THE LOS ANGELES URBAN COUNTY PROGRAM FOR COMMUNITY
  DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) FUNDS BY AUTHORIZING THE
  MAYOR, OR HIS DESIGNEE TO SIGN A COOPERATION AGREEMENT WITH
  THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES

  The City Council is requested to approve participation in the Los Angeles Urban
  County Program for CDBG funds.

  Recommendation:

  1. Adopt Resolution No. 26-5875 (Attachment “A”) approving participation in the
  Los Angeles Urban County Program for CDBG funds; and

  2. Authorize the Mayor, or his designee, to sign a cooperation agreement with the
  County of Los Angeles.

  Attachment:  Staff Report

  D. APPROVAL OF A CONSULTANT SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH SANDRA
  MEDRANO TO PROVIDE HOUSING SERVICES FOR THE CITY’S HOME
  IMPROVEMENT PROGRAMS

  The City Council is requested to approve a consultant services agreement to
  provide housing services.

  Recommendation:

  1. Review and approve a consultant services agreement (Attachment “A”) with
  Sandra Medrano (Medrano) to provide housing services for three years, with
  two optional one-year extensions, for a total compensation of $178,971. The
  total compensation shall not exceed 20 percent of the City’s Home Improvement
  Program’s budget;

  2. Authorize the City Manager to finalize and execute the consultant services
  agreement for three years beginning on July 1, 2026; and

  3. Authorize the City Manager to amend the consultant services agreement with
  Medrano for up to two additional years, in one-year increments. The total value
  of the consultant services agreement for future FYs shall not exceed $59,657 or
  20 percent of the City’s Home Improvement Program budget in those years,
  whichever is less.

  Attachment:  Staff Report
 City Council Agenda
June 3, 2026
Page 4 of 8

  E. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 26-5876 TO APPROVE THE ROAD REPAIR
  AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT (SB 1) PROJECT LIST FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026-27

  The City Council is requested to approve the resolution to designate citywide street
  resurfacing projects for FY 2026-27 RMRA funding under SB 1.

  Recommendation:

  1. Adopt Resolution No. 26-5876 (Attachment “A”) to approve the resurfacing of
  various streets citywide as Temple City’s designated project for Road
  Maintenance and Rehabilitation Account (RMRA) funds for Fiscal Year (FY)
  2026-27 pursuant to Senate Bill 1, the Road Repair and Accountability Act of
  2017 (SB 1);

  2. Direct the City Manager to include the corresponding Capital Improvement
  Projects (CIPs) in the FY 2026-27 City Budget including RMRA funds and the
  required General Fund maintenance of effort match; and

  3. Authorize the City Manager to submit the required documents and information to
  the California Transportation Commission (CTC) for the City to receive RMRA
  funds.

  Attachment:  Staff Report

  F. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 26-5878 ADOPTING THE STATEMENT OF
  INVESTMENT POLICY FOR FISCAL YEAR (FY) 2026-2027
  The City Council is requested to adopt the Statement of Investment Policy for Fiscal
  Year 2026-2027.

  Recommendation:  Adopt Resolution No. 26-5878 adopting the
  Statement of Investment Policy for FY 2026-2027.

  Attachment:  Staff Report

  G. VISA CARD REPORT
  The City Council is requested to review, receive, and file the Visa Card Report.

  Recommendation: receive and file

  Attachment:  Staff Report

  H. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 26-5879 APPROVING PAYMENT OF BILLS
  FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025-26
  The City Council is requested to adopt Resolution No. 26-5879 authorizing the
  payment of bills for fiscal year 2025-26.

  Recommendation:  Adopt Resolution No. 26-5879 authorizing the
  payment of bills for fiscal year 2025-26.

  Attachment:  Staff Report

8. PUBLIC HEARING

  A. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 26-5877 ORDERING THE LEVY OF
  CITYWIDE LIGHTING AND MAINTENANCE DISTRICT ASSESSMENTS FOR
  FISCAL YEAR (FY) 2026-2027

  The City Council is requested to adopt a resolution approving the ordering of the
  levy and collection of citywide Lighting and Maintenance District assessments for
  FY 2026-2027.

  Presenter:  Administrative Services Director

  Recommendation:

  1. Receive a presentation from staff;

  2. Open the public hearing; and

  3. Adopt Resolution No. 26-5877 ordering the levy and collection of assessments
  for FY 2026-2027.

  Attachment:  Staff Report

  B. INTRODUCTION AND FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NO. 26-1088,
  AMENDING CHAPTERS 9-2 (SUBDIVISION REGULATIONS) AND 9-3
  (CONDOMINIUM  CONVERSIONS),  AND  DELETING  CHAPTERS  9-4
  (CONDOMINIUM CONSTRUCTIONS) AND 9-6 (VESTING TENTATIVE MAPS) OF
  THE TEMPLE CITY MUNICIPAL CODE

  The City Council is requested to adopt an ordinance amending Chapter 9-2, 9-3,
  and 9-4 of the City's Municipal Code.

  Presenter:  Community Development Director

  Recommendation:
